correctness.rationale: The local current-balance telescoping identity proves uniform measure on each fixed-occupancy sector and hence Bernoulli product stationarity. The exact signed total current is Fq=u(1-u)(1+qv)+v(1-v)(1+qu), with any real q implemented by strictly positive forward/backward rates. Setting s=(u+v)/2,d=(u-v)/2 gives F=2s(1-s)(1+qs)+2[q(s-1)-1]d²; no nonzero-d interior maximizer exists by indefinite Hessian, and boundary maxima are 1/4 at half-filled single lane for q<0. The diagonal has unique maximizer xq and value S(q), crosses 1/4 exactly at qstar=-1.3570032053..., the unique root of 32q³+85q²+80q+32 in (-1.5,-1). Independently verified change-of-variables, resultant polynomial, and root using exact symbolic algebra. No dynamic density selection claimed.
